title: Ephesians Bible Quiz - Chapter 1
description: Ten questions on Ephesians 1: every spiritual blessing in Christ, redemption through his blood, the seal of the Holy Spirit, and a prayer for wisdom and revelation.

questions.text: To whom is this letter addressed in its first verse?
questions.explanation: Paul writes as an apostle of Christ Jesus through the will of God, to the saints who are at Ephesus and the faithful in Christ Jesus.

answers.text: To the assemblies of Galatia
To the brothers in Macedonia
To the saints who are at Ephesus
To the elders and their households

questions.text: With what does the chapter say God has blessed us in Christ?
questions.explanation: It blesses the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who has blessed us with every spiritual blessing in the heavenly places in Christ.

answers.text: With every spiritual blessing in the heavenly places
With peace in all the assemblies of Asia
With power over every kind of sickness
With an inheritance in the land

questions.text: When does the chapter say he chose us in him?
questions.explanation: It says he chose us in him before the foundation of the world, that we would be holy and without defect before him in love.

answers.text: When the fullness of the times came
Before the foundation of the world
When we first believed the Good News
In the days of the apostles

questions.text: Through what does the chapter say we have our redemption?
questions.explanation: It says that in him we have our redemption through his blood, the forgiveness of our trespasses, according to the riches of his grace.

answers.text: Through the law of commandments in ordinances
Through the prayers of all the saints
Through wisdom and prudence
Through his blood, the forgiveness of our trespasses

questions.text: With what were they sealed after they heard the word of the truth and believed?
questions.explanation: It says that having heard the word of the truth, the Good News of their salvation, and having believed, they were sealed with the promised Holy Spirit.

answers.text: With a new name
With the sign of circumcision
With the promised Holy Spirit
With the word of prophecy

questions.text: What is the Holy Spirit called in this chapter?
questions.explanation: It calls him a pledge of our inheritance, to the redemption of God's own possession, to the praise of his glory.

answers.text: A pledge of our inheritance
A witness against the world
A crown of righteousness
A light for the Gentiles

questions.text: What does Paul say he does for them, having heard of their faith and love?
questions.explanation: He says he does not cease to give thanks for them, making mention of them in his prayers.

answers.text: He writes to them every year
He sends teachers to them
He boasts of them in other places
He gives thanks for them in his prayers

questions.text: What does Paul ask that the God of our Lord Jesus Christ may give them?
questions.explanation: He asks that the Father of glory may give them a spirit of wisdom and revelation in the knowledge of him.

answers.text: Gifts of healing and tongues
A spirit of wisdom and revelation
Rest from all their troubles
Letters from the other apostles

questions.text: Where does the chapter say God made Christ to sit when he raised him from the dead?
questions.explanation: It says he raised him from the dead and made him to sit at his right hand in the heavenly places.

answers.text: In the midst of the assembly
On the throne of his father David
At his right hand in the heavenly places
Among the saints on the earth

questions.text: What does the chapter call the assembly, over which Christ was given as head?
questions.explanation: It says the assembly is his body, the fullness of him who fills all in all.

answers.text: His body, the fullness of him who fills all in all
A holy nation set apart for himself
A flock gathered from among the Gentiles
A city built on the hills of Zion
